components.text: The full leather set gives you +4.5 to the armour level (you can see this level under your health level). It can also be dyed into different colours.
Ingredients: 5 items of leather Leather cap gives +0.5 to the armour level
Ingredients: 8 items of leather Leather Tunic gives +1.5 to the armour level
Ingredients: 7 items of leather Leather Pants give +1 to the armour level
Ingredients: 4 items of leather Leather Boots give +0.5 to the armour level
The full iron set gives you +8.5 to the armour level (you can see this level under your health level). Iron set is the most commonly-worn set in the game.
Ingredients: 5 iron ingots Iron Helmet gives +1 to the armour level
Ingredients: 8 iron ingots Iron Chestplate gives +3 to the armour level
Ingredients: 7 iron ingots Iron Leggings give +2.5 to the armour level
Ingredients: 4 iron ingots Iron Boots give +1 to the armour level
The full golden set gives you +5.5 to the armour level (you can see this level under your health level)
Ingredients: 5 gold ingots Golden Helmet gives +1 to the armour level
Ingredients: 8 gold ingots Golden Chestplate gives +2.5 to the armour level
Ingredients: 7 gold ingots Golden Leggings give +1.5 to the armour level
Ingredients: 4 gold ingots Golden Boots give +0.5 to the armour level
The full diamond set gives you +10 to the armour level (you can see this level under your health level)
Ingredients: 5 diamonds Diamond Helmet gives +1.5 to the armour level
Ingredients: 8 diamonds Diamond Chestplate gives +4 to the armour level
Ingredients: 7 diamonds Diamond Leggings give +3 to the armour level
Ingredients: 4 diamonds Diamond Boots give +1.5 to the armour level
The full chain set gives you +6 to the armour level (you can see this level under your health level). The chain set protects you from lava. It's impossible to craft a chain set in survival.
Ingredients: 5 items of fire Chain Helmet gives +1 to the armour level
Ingredients: 8 items of fire Chain Chestplate gives +2.5 to the armour level
Ingredients: 7 items of fire Chain Leggings give +2 to the armour level
Ingredients: 4 items of fire Chain Boots give +0.5 to the armour level
Ingredients: 6 wood planks, 1 iron ingot Shields are tools used for protecting the player against attacks.
